name: weathered trail sign
description: A crooked blackened-pine post where the thicket's paths fork. The board is split and rimed, its letters gouged with a knife and darkened with soot. Someone keeps this marker standing.

params.success_message:
You scrape the frost off the board and read the gouged letters.

ICY ARCH — a low passage, to Snowbound Hollow. Duck your head.
ROCKY SLOPE — a cleft in the bank, to Frozen Hollow. A dead-end; the old well stands there.
WILLOW GAP — through the curtain of branches, to Weeping Willow Hollow. Warm and sheltered. Mind the roots.
FROSTED ARCHWAY — to Frozen Lake Clearing. The ice is thin near the reeds.
ICE BRIDGE — across the stream, to Frozen Stream Crossing. Then follow the bank down to the lake.

Below that, gouged deeper and half-scratched out: 'Valerious — not this way. Under the hill. The dark.'
